name: Asagiri Realms
description:
Welcome to Asagiri Realms — a modded Bedrock survival server for explorers, builders, and boss hunters.

Jump into an infinite world filled with custom biomes, hidden dungeons, and legendary boss fights. Server add-ons load automatically when you join — no manual pack installs needed.

Explore & fight Discover rare biomes, ocean regions, and Better Structures across the map. Track down Bosses Rise dungeons and take on epic fights — Ashlord the Dragon, Nerakyss the Kraken, Helvar the Soul Knight, sandworms, yetis, and more. Each boss is a real challenge with unique loot, weapons, and armor.

Survive & build Essentials SMP gives you land claims and grief protection so your base stays safe. Set homes, use teleport tools, and play real SMP — not anarchy.

Progress & atmosphere Levels Matter adds RPG-style progression as you play. Nature Add-On and enhanced biomes make the world feel richer and more alive. Vibrant Realism visuals round out the experience.

Whether you want to solo the wilderness, team up for bosses, or settle down and build, there's a place for you here. Asagiri is a new, growing realm — help shape it from the start.
